description: Use the fewer-than-three-band-samples branch and verify positive half-way delay rounding, first retained sample, and output length.

oracle.description: The isolated 0.4 Hz bin is the only occupied-band sample, so 2 * 0.5 / 0.4 = 2.5 rounds upward to delay 3. The outputs therefore correspond to m[2:] and contain four samples. With the impulse respiration, the rank-one subspace retains only the first delayed sample.
